title: Odile and the Border
author: Gideon Eriksen
blurb: Vesper Voss, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
